sources: Wikipedia: Omegle: launched March 25, 2009 by Leif K-Brooks, then 18, from Vermont; shut down November 8, 2023, after 14 years.
Wikipedia: Chatroulette: created November 2009 by Andrey Ternovskiy, then 17, a Russian student living in Moscow.

scenes.say: Two teenagers started stranger chat sites in the same year.
In March 2009, eighteen-year-old Leif K-Brooks in Vermont launched Omegle.
That November, seventeen-year-old Andrey Ternovskiy launched Chatroulette from Moscow.
Omegle ran for fourteen years, until it shut down in November 2023.
But wanting to talk to someone new didn't shut down with it.

scenes.tagline: Someone new is one tap away.
